question: How have gross margin and operating margin changed over the last three years, and what drove the change?

answer.summary: Gross margin expanded over the three-year window, rising from 41.8% in FY2021 [F01390] to 43.3% in FY2022 [F01391] (+153 bps) and 44.1% in FY2023 [F01392] (+82 bps), even as gross profit dollars peaked at $170.78B in FY2022 [F00026] before declining 1.0% to $169.15B in FY2023 [F00025]. Operating margin followed a similar but flatter path, improving from 29.8% in FY2021 [F01393] to 30.3% in FY2022 [F01394] (+51 bps) then retreating to 29.8% in FY2023 [F01395] (-47 bps), returning to the FY2021 level. The gross margin expansion was driven by cost of revenue growing only +5.0% in FY2022 [F00023] versus revenue +7.8% [F00014] and declining -4.2% in FY2023 [F00022] versus revenue -2.8% [F00013], alongside a mix shift toward higher-margin Services. Operating margin compression in FY2023 coincides with operating expenses rising +6.8% to $54.85B [F00034], led by R&D up +14.0% to $29.91B [F00028], while operating income fell -4.3% to $114.30B [F00037].
drivers: FY2022 gross margin +153 bps: cost of revenue +5.0% [F00023] grew slower than revenue +7.8% [F00014]
FY2023 gross margin +82 bps: cost of revenue -4.2% [F00022] declined faster than revenue -2.8% [F00013], plus mix shift toward Services (+7.7% [F01005]) offsetting Products (-5.2% [F01003])
FY2022 operating margin +51 bps: operating income +9.6% [F00038] grew faster than revenue +7.8% [F00014]
FY2023 operating margin -47 bps: operating expenses +6.8% [F00034] outpaced revenue decline, with R&D +14.0% [F00028] the largest contributor to the $3.50B expense increase
FY2023 gross profit -$1.63B net change: Products -$5.92B [F01003] was the largest contributor, partially offset by Services +$4.29B [F01006]
risks_and_red_flags: Operating margin declined -47 bps in FY2023 [F01395], erasing the entire FY2022 improvement of +51 bps [F01394]
R&D expense grew +14.0% [F00028] while revenue declined -2.8% [F00013], indicating rising cost base amid top-line weakness
Products gross profit fell -5.2% [F01003] in FY2023, the largest contributor to the gross profit decline
Foreign currency weakness relative to the U.S. dollar is cited as a recurring headwind to both Products and Services margins [T00330][T00331][T00333][T00334]
Operating income declined -4.3% [F00037] in FY2023, the first annual decline in the three-year window
data_quality_notes: 4 duplicate facts with conflicting values were set aside during parsing; the primary-statement value was kept
Same pattern for Services: T00333 reports gross margin increased while T00334 reports gross margin percentage decreased, consistent with dollars vs ratio distinction
No forward-looking guidance facts present in the retrieved evidence

outlook.actuals_view: Margins peaked in FY2022 (gross 43.3% [F01391], operating 30.3% [F01394]) and FY2023 shows compression in operating margin (-47 bps [F01395]) despite continued gross margin expansion (+82 bps [F01392]), as operating expense growth outpaced revenue
outlook.forward_looking_guidance: not in the retrieved evidence - no management guidance facts were present in the filing evidence provided
